newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline slips $3, corrects Thursday rally.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline slips $3, corrects Thursday rally.

text.p: NWE took a tumble on Friday as NYMEX gasoline reversed earlier gains. Dealers said physical barrels had lost $3 a tonne or so while swaps were down around $5.
"It was all a bit overcooked and excessive yesterday (when the market jumped) and today has been a correction," commented one trader.
Eurograde gasoline barges that were sold in the morning at $191.00, $193.00 and $193.50 fob would have had trouble finding an interested buyer in the high $180s by late afternoon, dealers said.
A more supportive note was the continued strength of naphtha which some traders felt could lead refiners to maximise naphtha output to the detriment of gasoline.
"Its possible it may be tight for gasoline next week," said one trader.
Physical activity was fairly muted in spite of the fall in prices.
"I think a lot of sellers feel the market has been oversold in the same way it was overbid yesterday and they are looking for a further correction upwards next week," said one broker.
U.S. interest was expected to remain strong which will also give comfort to market players contemplating an arbitrage move.
